messages:
leo: Hey folks — CI is red on my PR #1124. Only the matrix job 'integration' shard 3 failed, everything else green. Is there a way to retrigger just that shard without forcing a full image rebuild?

maya: Yep. Two options depending on how confident you are that the image is fine: our infra CLI (preserves build/image) or the GH API/UI (might trigger rebuild). Which run id do you have?

leo: run id 987654321 (from Actions page). failing job name shows 'integration (shard 3)'.

ci-bot: infra note: run 987654321 — image build step SUCCEEDED at 2025-11-03T10:21:00Z. Preserving image allowed.

maya: Recommended (infra CLI - preserves build):
```
infra ci rerun --run-id 987654321 --job "integration" --shard 3 --keep-image
```
This will queue only that job/shard and re-use the already-built image/artifacts.

maya: If you don't have the infra CLI, GitHub API fallback (more manual):
1) find the job id:
```
gh api repos/:org/:repo/actions/runs/987654321/jobs | jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="integration (shard 3)") | .id'
```
2) trigger rerun for that job id:
```
gh api -X POST repos/:org/:repo/actions/jobs/<job_id>/rerun
```
Note: GH endpoints sometimes re-schedule related steps depending on labels/runner pools — infra CLI is safer if you specifically need to avoid rebuilds.

tariq: small gotcha — if the failure is due to missing cache layers or corrupted workspace, preserving the image won't help. Use the infra CLI flag only for flaky test re-runs where the build is known-good.

leo: good point. This looks like a flaky network test in that shard, so reusing the image should be fine. Is there an easy way to run the same shard a few times to get a pass rate?

maya: We have a quick bisect/retry helper:
```
infra ci bisect --run-id 987654321 --job integration --shard 3 --tries 5
```
That will re-run the same shard up to N times (preserving build) and report pass/fail counts. Useful before opening an oncall ticket.

sasha: If you have no infra access, UI path: Actions page -> three dots -> "Re-run jobs" -> "Re-run failed jobs". It can be fine for a one-off, but it sometimes re-triggers parts of the workflow so be careful with long image builds.

leo: queued the infra CLI rerun. CI bot posted: "Queued job: integration (shard 3), preserve-image=true, queue id 5555". Thanks!

maya: If it flakes again, please ping #eng-oncall and paste the run id + the infra rerun queue id. Also leave a short PR comment tagging @maya and @tariq so we can triage post-merge if needed.

leo: Will do. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job 5555 completed: PASS.

leo: Amazing — merging now, thanks everyone.
